raw_text: Victim Ananya Sharma, age 21, was last seen near Charbagh Railway Station. Witness Imran Khan reported a white vehicle UP 32 AB 1234. Her final call was to +91 98765 43210. No prior link to another missing-person case was recorded.

Victim Meera Singh, age 19, disappeared after leaving Barabanki Bus Stand. CCTV notes mention vehicle UP-32-AB-1234. A message asked her to transfer travel fees to safehouse@ybl. The vehicle description was not compared with records outside the district.

Missing person Kavya Yadav, age 22, contacted a placement agent using phone 9876543210. Transaction notes show a payment to safehouse@ybl. Suspect Arjun Verma was described only as a recruiter; no vehicle was observed.
Victim Pooja Mishra, age 20, was last seen near Ayodhya Cantt. Witness Rohit Das photographed vehicle UP32 AB 1234. A UPI request from safehouse@ybl was found on the victim's phone.

Victim Riya Gupta, age 18, travelled toward Lucknow after speaking with caller Arjun Verma on 9123456780. The caller also contacted 9876543210 shortly before the disappearance. Officers recorded the calls but had not associated them with FIR-LKO-001 or FIR-STP-003.
